Name: Smaller 2nd house
Author: solflo
Description:
[b]feb 27th 2023: UM HI GUYS[/b]

i just made this mod for myself and dropped it here in case anyone wanted to use it, and then never checked in on it again (nexus didn't notify me about your comments at all). plus i didn't play much stardew since.

it was a clumsy hacked together mod, and while i'm very glad people used and enjoyed it, i won't be upkeeping it :(

i'm not entirely sure if the 1.5 update broke it, or if it was something from content patcher. in any case, i'm sorry i can't help those of you who asked, sorry i didn't answer any of yall in time, when i might have been able to do troubleshoot. i haven't checked if there's another mod filling this gap, but if there isn't just know that it was fairly simple back when i made it! it's just a map mod, so i recommend looking into that if you're interested.

ok byee didn't expect this to have had any downloads at all honestly! i won't make it invisible for archiving sake (hey maybe you wanna play on 1.4 for some reason? maybe the files can be salvaged and fixed if anyone wants to?) so uh. yeah it's defunct ^_^

=============================================

i hate the final farmhouse size, it's just so big and impossible to decorate. but the one mod that does this is not CP compatible and there's an unmovable fireplace in the kitchen. so i taught myself how to edit a map and went ahead and... made it. it's my first sdv mod ever, so it's pretty basic, and also my first time uploading on nexus, so forgive anything. it works ok for me and that's the target audience oof

if you're already at this upgrade, remove any furniture on the extra bedrooms and [b]for V1:[/b] the bottom two rows of the whole house / [b]for V2:[/b] the farmer's bedroom

[b]V1[/b] has a smaller kitchen and bedroom, but it's not compatible with the cellar (idk how to modify the stair placement so it's ugly and only accessible bc you can clip through the wall -- yea, i need to fix that, but it doesn't happen on V2)
[b]V2[/b] keeps the original kitchen (i tried making it smaller from the top but it really [i]really[/i] didn't work), but has a much smaller bedroom (because i found V1's bedroom still too large for my liking)

i'm not really up to making a version with both the original kitchen [i]and[/i]  V1's bedroom atm, but who knows what the future holds. in the meantime you can teach yourself how to do this. be the change you wanna see in the modding world

anyway, feel free to modify this in any way, i don't care

[b]NOTE:[/b] none of the versions modify the marriage houses bc 1) i don't plan on marrying, 2) that'd mean making extra versions with the cribs, 3) there's prolly also pathing to worry about. so i don't think i'll ever make a marriage version of this mod

Downloads.Description: looks ugly with the cellar, but works fine (except for the whole clipping through the wall thing)
cellar compatible, original kitchen, tiny bedroom
